description: International standard for metadata to support the preservation of digital objects and ensure their long-term usability. Defines semantic units for four core entities: Object, Event, Agent, and Rights.

entities.name: Object
entities.description: Discrete unit of information in digital form that is the target of digital preservation. The objectCategory determines whether it is an Intellectual Entity, Representation, File, or Bitstream.
entities.note: Root entity in the PREMIS data model. Every Object must have an objectIdentifier and objectCategory.

entities.name: Intellectual Entity
entities.description: A set of content that is reasonably described as a unit for purposes of management and description: for example, a particular book, map, photograph, or database. An Intellectual Entity can include other Intellectual Entities.
entities.note: Highest level of aggregation. Not all PREMIS semantic units apply to Intellectual Entities.

entities.name: Representation
entities.description: The set of all file objects needed to render an Intellectual Entity. For example, a journal article may be complete in one PDF file; this single file constitutes the representation.
entities.note: A digital Representation of an Intellectual Entity. An IE may have multiple Representations.

entities.name: File
entities.description: A named and ordered sequence of bytes that is known to an operating system.
entities.note: File-level Objects carry the majority of technical metadata in PREMIS.

entities.name: Bitstream
entities.description: Contiguous or non-contiguous data within a file that has meaningful common properties for preservation purposes.
entities.note: A Bitstream is data within a File. Not all Files contain identifiable Bitstreams.

entities.name: Object Characteristics
entities.description: Technical properties of a File or Bitstream that are applicable to all or most formats. Mandatory for File and Bitstream objects.
entities.note: Container for fixity, size, format, creating application, and inhibitor information.

entities.name: Fixity
entities.description: Information used to verify whether an object has been altered in an undocumented manner. Uses message digest algorithms to create checksums.
entities.note: Part of objectCharacteristics. Repeatable for multiple algorithms.

entities.name: Format
entities.description: Identification of the format of a File or Bitstream. Format is mandatory within objectCharacteristics.
entities.note: Can be identified via formatDesignation (name/version) and/or formatRegistry (e.g. PRONOM).

entities.name: Creating Application
entities.description: Information about the application that created the object.

entities.name: Inhibitors
entities.description: Features of the object intended to inhibit access, use, or migration. For example, encryption or password protection.

entities.name: Storage
entities.description: Information about the location and medium of the stored object. Applicable to Representation, File, and Bitstream.

entities.name: Signature Information
entities.description: Digital signature information used for authentication and integrity verification of File and Bitstream objects.

entities.name: Environment
entities.description: Technical environment (hardware, software, other technology) needed to render and use the object. Applicable to Intellectual Entity type objects used as environment descriptions.
entities.note: In PREMIS 3.0, environment is modeled as an Intellectual Entity with environment-specific semantic units.

entities.name: Environment Function
entities.description: The type and level of the environment function. For example, whether the environment provides rendering, editing, or creation capability.

entities.name: Environment Designation
entities.description: Information identifying the hardware, software, or other technology needed to render and use the object.

entities.name: Environment Registry
entities.description: Reference to an entry for this environment in a registry.

entities.name: Relationship
entities.description: Information about relationships between this Object and other Objects, Events, or Agents. For example, a Representation is related to its Intellectual Entity via a 'structural' relationship.
entities.note: Applies to all Object types. Used to express structural, derivation, and dependency relationships.

entities.name: Event
entities.description: An action that involves or affects at least one Object or Agent known to the preservation repository.
entities.note: Records preservation actions and changes. Linked to Objects and Agents via linking identifiers.

entities.name: Agent
entities.description: Actor (person, organization, or software) associated with preservation Events in the life of an Object.
entities.note: In PREMIS 3.0, Person/Organization/Software are values of agentType, not separate entities.

entities.name: Rights Statement
entities.description: An assertion of one or more rights or permissions pertaining to an Object and/or Agent. Contains the basis for the rights (copyright, license, statute, or other) and the specific rights granted.
entities.note: Fourth core entity in the PREMIS data model. Links to Objects and Agents.

entities.name: Copyright Information
entities.description: Copyright information that serves as the basis for a rights statement. Applicable when rightsBasis is 'copyright'.

entities.name: License Information
entities.description: License information that serves as the basis for a rights statement. Applicable when rightsBasis is 'license'.

entities.name: Statute Information
entities.description: A law that grants permission for an action on an object or limits use of an object. Applicable when rightsBasis is 'statute'.

entities.name: Other Rights Information
entities.description: Rights information not covered by copyright, license, or statute. Applicable when rightsBasis is 'other'.

entities.name: Rights Granted
entities.description: The permission or permissions granted within a rights statement. Specifies the act permitted, any restrictions, and the term of the grant.

entities.name: Linking Identifier
entities.description: Information used to link a PREMIS entity to related Objects, Events, Agents, or Rights Statements. Present as sub-elements within each core entity.
entities.note: Linking identifiers appear within Object (linkingEventIdentifier, linkingRightsStatementIdentifier), Event (linkingAgentIdentifier, linkingObjectIdentifier), Agent (linkingEventIdentifier, linkingRightsStatementIdentifier, linkingEnvironmentIdentifier), and Rights Statement (linkingObjectIdentifier, linkingAgentIdentifier).

eventTypes.capture: The process whereby a repository actively obtains an object
eventTypes.compression: The process of coding data to save storage space or transmission time
eventTypes.creation: The act of creating a new object
eventTypes.deaccession: The process of removing an object from the inventory of a repository
eventTypes.decompression: The process of reversing the effects of compression
eventTypes.decryption: The process of converting encrypted data to plaintext
eventTypes.deletion: The process of removing an object from repository storage
eventTypes.digital_signature_generation: The process of generating a digital signature for an object
eventTypes.digital_signature_validation: The process of determining that a decrypted digital signature matches an expected value
eventTypes.dissemination: The process of creating a copy for or sending to a user
eventTypes.filename_assignment: The act of assigning a new filename to an object
eventTypes.fixity_check: The process of verifying that an object has not been changed in an undocumented manner
eventTypes.forensic_feature_analysis: The process of analyzing low-level features of a digital object for forensic purposes
eventTypes.format_identification: The process of determining the format of an object
eventTypes.imaging: The process of creating a bit-accurate reproduction of a physical or analog original
eventTypes.information_package_creation: The process of creating an information package
eventTypes.information_package_merging: The process of combining two or more information packages
eventTypes.information_package_splitting: The process of dividing one information package into two or more
eventTypes.ingestion: The process of adding objects to a preservation repository
eventTypes.message_digest_calculation: The process by which a message digest (checksum) is created
eventTypes.metadata_extraction: The process of extracting metadata from an object
eventTypes.metadata_modification: The process of modifying existing metadata for an object
eventTypes.migration: A transformation of an object creating a version in a more contemporary format
eventTypes.normalization: A transformation of an object creating a version more conducive to preservation
eventTypes.packing: The process of combining objects into a container format
eventTypes.policy_assignment: The process of assigning a preservation or access policy to an object
eventTypes.quarantine: The process of isolating an object from repository access
eventTypes.recovery: The process of restoring an object from backup or disaster recovery storage
eventTypes.redaction: The process of removing or obscuring content to protect sensitive information
eventTypes.refreshment: The process of copying content to the same or newer media type without change
eventTypes.replication: The process of creating a copy of an object that is bitwise identical to the original
eventTypes.transfer: The process of moving an object between storage locations
eventTypes.unpacking: The process of extracting objects from a container format
eventTypes.unquarantine: The process of removing an object from quarantine
eventTypes.validation: The process of comparing an object with a standard and noting compliance or exceptions
eventTypes.virus_check: The process of scanning a file for malicious programs

objectCategories.intellectual_entity: A set of content that is reasonably described as a unit
objectCategories.representation: The set of all file objects needed to render an intellectual entity
objectCategories.file: A named and ordered sequence of bytes known to an operating system
objectCategories.bitstream: Contiguous or non-contiguous data within a file with meaningful properties

preservationLevelValues.bit-level: Ensure the bits are preserved exactly as received
preservationLevelValues.full: Full preservation including format migration and emulation as needed
preservationLevelValues.logical: Preserve the logical/intellectual content regardless of format changes

preservationLevelRoles.capability: The level of preservation the repository is capable of providing
preservationLevelRoles.intention: The level of preservation the repository intends to provide
preservationLevelRoles.requirement: The level of preservation required for this object

relationshipTypes.structural: Describes how objects are combined to form logical or physical groupings
relationshipTypes.derivation: Describes how one object was created from another
relationshipTypes.dependency: Describes how one object requires another to support its function, delivery, or rendering
relationshipTypes.reference: Describes non-structural, non-dependency associations between objects
relationshipTypes.replacement: Describes how one object replaces another

relationshipSubTypes.has_root: Structural: an IE has a root representation
relationshipSubTypes.has_part: Structural: a representation has files as parts
relationshipSubTypes.is_part_of: Structural: a file is part of a representation
relationshipSubTypes.includes: Structural: a bitstream is included in a file
relationshipSubTypes.is_included_in: Structural: a file includes a bitstream
relationshipSubTypes.has_source: Derivation: object was derived from the source
relationshipSubTypes.is_source_of: Derivation: object is the source for a derivation
relationshipSubTypes.requires: Dependency: object requires another for rendering
relationshipSubTypes.is_required_by: Dependency: object is required by another for rendering
relationshipSubTypes.is_referenced_by: Reference: object is referenced by another
relationshipSubTypes.is_replaced_by: Replacement: object is replaced by another

rightsBasisValues.license: Rights basis is a license agreement
rightsBasisValues.statute: Rights basis is a legal statute
rightsBasisValues.other: Rights basis is something other than copyright, license, or statute

actValues.delete: Permission to remove an object from the repository
actValues.disseminate: Permission to create a copy for or send to a user
actValues.migrate: Permission to transform to a different format
actValues.modify: Permission to change the content of an object
actValues.replicate: Permission to create an exact copy
actValues.use: Permission to access or use an object

restrictionValues.conditional: Action is allowed under specific conditions

environmentFunctionTypes.rendering: The environment is for rendering the object
environmentFunctionTypes.editing: The environment is for editing the object
environmentFunctionTypes.creating: The environment is for creating the object
environmentFunctionTypes.executing: The environment is for executing the object

environmentFunctionLevels.known_to_work: The environment is known to work

formatRegistryNames.PRONOM: PRONOM Technical Registry (The National Archives, UK)
formatRegistryNames.MIME: IANA Media Types (Internet Assigned Numbers Authority)

storageMediumValues.hard_disk: Internal or external hard disk drive
